motion.evidence: Probe: 48 scroll effects (28 pin (fixed) on figure/project divs + 20 transform/parallax, trigger in-view) on the project plates and margin-credit spans; 779 requestAnimationFrame callbacks; 1 <canvas>; transRules 18; keyframeCount 0; 0 IntersectionObserver / 0 scroll / 0 mousemove listeners; 0 prefers-reduced-motion rules (respectsReducedMotion:false); no library global detected (rAF+pin+position:fixed fingerprint => smooth-scroll engine inferred, not asserted). Transitions: 0.8s x39 + 1.6s x38 on cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), plus one-offs 1s/0.6s/0.4s(ease)/3.5s. FRAMES ARE WEAK EVIDENCE: scroll-capture stalled — s02..s10 byte-identical, s00..s02 differ <1% (top-bar clock cols 0-1/9-10, small center+margin settle band 4-5, footer band 9); pin/parallax choreography is probe-derived and frame-unconfirmed.

notes: Monochrome capture, confirmed by screenshots: only white/black/one grey (#c9c9c9); raw profile lists no accent hue, so accent is null on purpose. Type collapsed from raw 11px/80px to 0.6875rem/5rem (~7x ratio); single 400-weight custom face 'Obys'. Raw body line-height 13.2px on 11px ≈ 1.2 leading; display line-height equals font-size (1.0). Tracking: craft sampler captured only the body (11px -> -0.11px ≈ -0.01em); the display -0.03em (-2.4px on 80px) is from the raw letterSpacing profile, single-source. Padding/gap rounded from raw ~1px and ~10px; the 1px box padding is the brutalist edge-to-edge box treatment, kept as the smallest space step. radius=0 and shadow=none inferred from screenshots (no rounding or elevation visible; raw profile carries no radius/shadow data). Grid: raw 12-col desktop -> 4-col mobile is the underlying CSS-grid track count; the rendered layout is 1 centered spine + 2 margin rails (frame-estimated). States: only link :focus captured (outline 1px rgb(16,16,16); focus_visible:false); no button/card/input/disabled states; supportsDark:false. A11y defects: reduced_motion not respected, focus-visible false, 83/198 small tap targets; img_alt_ratio 1.0 is the one pass. Motion durations are spectacle-scale (0.8s/1.6s, one 3.5s) on a single expo-out curve — durations should NOT be ported to product UI; the curve can be. Screenshot is the source of truth where it disagrees with the noisy raw counts; per motion.evidence, frames are weak (stalled scroll) so pin/parallax are probe-derived.
